outputs.explanation: Panel A shows spatial deconvolution maps overlaid on tissue images (micrographs with per-spot heatmap coloring), not a summary plot of averaged data requiring individual point overlay.

Panel B is a box plot showing medians/quartiles for each immune cell population, and individual data points (dots for each biological replicate) are overlaid on top of the boxes for both LUSC and LUAD groups.
Panel C shows GSEA enrichment line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data points since overlaying points would make the running-score line unreadable.

Panel D is a bar graph where each bar represents a single computed statistic (log2 fold change from DEG analysis) per gene, not a mean across multiple biological replicates, so there are no individual data points to overlay.
Panel E consists of representative H&E and IHC micrograph images, not a plot of averaged/aggregated data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
